in_sanskrit.name: Gurjant
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Guru's Sword
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gurjant एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Gurjant is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘guru’ meaning teacher or guide and ‘jant’ meaning sword. This name is symbolic of a spiritual warrior who is guided by their guru and uses their wisdom and courage to protect and serve.
